headlines.title: 한국판 IRA 내년 도입 …반도체·2차전지 등 생산 세액공제

top5_headlines.title: AI · 반도체 국내생산 세액공제 … SMR도 최대 50% [2026 세제개편안]
top5_headlines.summary: 로봇·이차전지 등 6대분야 신설 지방 생산 기업일수록 우대 적용 정부가 인공지능(AI)·로봇과 반도체, 이차전지 등 경제안보 핵심 품목을 국내에서 직접 생산해 판매하는 기업에 세금을 깎아주는 ‘국내생산세액공제’를 신설한다. 소형모듈원전(SMR)과 초소형모듈원전(MMR)도 국가전략기술에 새로 포함해 연구개발(R&D) 비용의 최대 50%를 세액공제한다.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Drives Record Tax Revenue; Could Exceed 500 Trillion Won This Year
key_headlines.summary: First-half national tax revenue reached 223 trillion won, up 33 trillion won year-over-year. Samsung and SK Hynix interim corporate tax payments expected to drive second-half surge, with potential for 450 trillion won this year and breakthrough to 500 trillion won next year.

key_headlines.title: Core Inflation Accelerates Despite Headline CPI Decline to 2% Range
key_headlines.summary: July consumer price inflation fell to 2.8% in three months, but core inflation hit a 2-year-7-month high, strengthening the case for consecutive interest rate hikes amid demand-side pressures.

key_headlines.title: Government Introduces Tax Credits for Domestic AI, Semiconductor, and Clean Energy Production
key_headlines.summary: New domestic production tax credits established for AI, robots, semiconductors, secondary batteries, and other strategic industries. Small modular reactors (SMR) included as strategic technology with up to 50% R&D tax deductions.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Committee Signals Need for Continued Rate Hikes
key_headlines.summary: BOK officials expressed that the necessity for rate increases has grown while burdens have eased, citing demand-side price pressures from strong economic growth. July rate hike deemed insufficient by some committee members.

key_headlines.title: Real Estate Tax Overhaul Creates Market Uncertainty; Concerns Over Declining Jeonse Supply
key_headlines.summary: 2026 real estate tax reform significantly increases burden on non-resident single-homeowners and high-value property holders, with concerns that punitive taxation could reduce jeonse supply and push owners toward liquidation.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing strong momentum driven by semiconductor sector strength, with first-half tax revenue reaching historic levels 33 trillion won above the previous year. The semiconductor boom is expected to continue propelling tax collection higher, with potential for breaking through 500 trillion won annually. However, this growth is creating demand-side inflation pressures, as evidenced by accelerating core inflation despite headline consumer price inflation moderating to 2.8% in July. The government is strategically supporting future growth through new tax incentives for AI, semiconductors, and clean energy production to secure economic competitiveness.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee has signaled strengthening conviction for continued interest rate hikes, citing demand-side inflation pressures from robust economic growth. Second-quarter GDP grew 3.7% year-over-year and 0.6% quarter-over-quarter, with real gross national income surging 15.6% annually due to improved terms of trade from semiconductor export prices. Core inflation reached 2-year-7-month highs despite headline CPI falling to 2%, complicating the central bank's August decision. Committee members have expressed concern that government mega-project fiscal spending could increase bond market volatility.
sections.Financial Markets: Semiconductor-driven stock market gains are facing headwinds as US Treasury increases long-term debt issuance, potentially pushing long-term interest rates higher and pressuring growth stocks like semiconductors and AI companies. Convertible bond issuance has plummeted on KOSDAQ as investors retreat from mid-cap companies, reflecting broader market concentration in large-cap stocks. US long-term Treasury yields reached their highest levels since the 2007 global financial crisis following the latest FOMC meeting, creating uncertainty for future Korean equity performance. Market participants are closely watching US long-term interest rates as the key determinant for semiconductor stock direction.
sections.Industry & Technology: Semiconductor dominance is attracting capital from major industrial sectors, with regional employment in semiconductors, shipbuilding, and automobiles driving workforce growth of over 140,000 in provincial areas over the past year. The government is preparing the 12th basic electricity plan for September-October release and is implementing the Korean Green Transformation (K-GX) strategy targeting 50% electric vehicle adoption by 2030. Key mineral procurement and supply chain diversification remain priorities for economic security. Educational institutions are strengthening semiconductor workforce development programs to support industry demands.
sections.Real Estate: The 2026 real estate tax overhaul is creating significant market uncertainty by differentiating comprehensive property tax basic deductions between resident (14 billion won) and non-resident (9 billion won) single-homeowners. The punitive tax approach for non-resident single-homeowners threatens to reduce jeonse supply as owners are pressured toward liquidation, potentially destabilizing the rental market. Property prices outside Gangnam are rising to match Gangnam levels, with regions like Joong-rang and Nowon seeing rapid appreciation. Concerns are mounting that the property tax burden, already at 3.0% of GDP compared to OECD average of 1.6%, will further destabilize the housing market.
sections.International Economy: The US stock market reached new all-time highs with the Dow climbing and NASDAQ up 2%, driven by falling oil prices and reduced long-term interest rate expectations. The Federal Reserve maintained interest rates at the July meeting, but CME FedWatch shows 66.5% probability of at least 25 basis point rate increase in September. The Trump administration's forced labor tariffs on 60 economic jurisdictions producing 99.4% of US imports face legal challenges from 25 US states. JP Morgan suggests the Fed may need to raise rates again in September if inflation concerns persist, impacting Korean export competitiveness.
sections.AI & Economy: President emphasizes that the AI-centered industrial transformation requires bold investment and rapid execution, stressing the importance of export market diversification and stable supply chains. South Korea is expanding investment in semiconductors, AI, and clean energy sectors through bilateral partnerships, particularly with Vietnam. Korean companies like ES Politech reported US exports surging 78.9% in first half driven by AI data center and aerospace materials demand. China's government is backing AI as a national strategic industry, integrating it across manufacturing, agriculture, services, and scientific research, with CEOs' AI strategies now determining corporate survival.
sections.Others: American public opinion shows Democrats regaining advantage on economic stewardship after Trump's approval rating fell to 35% due to surging oil prices from Iran tensions. Denmark has implemented conscription expansion requiring even the second-in-line to the throne to complete 11 months of military service in response to Russian threats and Trump administration pressures. Food industry companies are reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 20,000 tons through recycled materials and equipment improvements to comply with stricter global carbon regulations. Government is expanding social safety nets to self-employed and single-person small business operators, providing childcare support and customized assistance combining R&D, investment, and export support.
